findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice mcqs for Unit 11 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 75 questions numbered 1-75; by section: 11.1 5, 11.1.1 5, 11.1.2 4, 11.1.3 4, 11.2 7, 11.3 8, 11.4 7, 11.4.1 3, 11.4.2 6, 11.4.3 6, 11.4.4 5, 11.5 9, 11.5.1 6. Keys: {'a': 19, 'b': 18, 'c': 19, 'd': 19}.

Covers every section of Unit 11 in book order (domains and ranges of the six functions, even and odd functions, periods, values by the allied-angle identities, the graphs of sin, cos and tan, maximum and minimum of a + b sin(c theta + d) and reciprocals, and the applications). Every key was checked by computation in Python (sympy); none repeats an exercise question or a book example. Book corrections followed: minimum of cos x is -1; tan x tends to minus infinity just right of 90 degrees and of -90 degrees; with b < 0 the maximum occurs where the sine or cosine is -1; 0 < x <= 1 (not 0 <= x) for the range of secant.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
